keyrings.subtitle: Attaché Case (KeyRing) Catalog v1.10.1 (Max: Lv. 30). Equip up to 3 keyrings at once. Epic and Legendary rarity effects apply passively from inventory.
keyrings.importance_desc: Keyring main effects apply automatically without needing to equip them, but do not stack if you have duplicates of the exact same type. Sub-stats do require keyrings to be equipped to activate and scale with level.
keyrings.mechanics_desc: When obtaining a keyring, 1 of 5 initial candidate rolls is selected (each with a fixed 20% probability). When upgrading to Lv. 30, growth per level is identical, so the initial candidate defines the min or max final stat.
keyrings.bug_desc: The in-game tooltip mistakenly shows inflated values (e.g. +12.13% instead of +3.90% to +4.30%) due to adding sub-stats to the display. The values here reflect actual in-game combat values.

luminio.datamine_note: 💡 Datamine Intel: Fully completing one branch of Luminium technology requires exactly 27,314 Powder and 21,010 Stones. For all 3 branches combined, the cost reaches 81,942 Powder and 63,032 Stones.

rules.bp_to_adv_polish: Mandatory path for Mythic grade pieces. Requires 10 Blueprints per unit.
rules.bp_to_polish: Yields 3 Polish per Blueprint. Useful if you have surplus blueprints and need polish to advance tiers.
rules.bp_to_gold_frag: High return (300 Fragments per Blueprint). Much more efficient than converting through intermediate polish.
rules.polish_to_bp: Depreciation rate (10:1). Only recommended if you urgently need a blueprint for an ascension.
rules.polish_to_gold_frag: Yields 50 Fragments per Polish. Generous weekly limit of 1,000 units.
rules.gold_frag_to_bp: High cost (1,000 Fragments per Blueprint) but excellent for burning massive gold surplus on scarce blueprints.
rules.gold_frag_to_polish: 200 Fragments per Polish. Significantly cheaper than buying blueprints first to convert them into polish.
